observations: auth_login calls provider.start_login and stores provider, state, and verifier in hermes_session_pkce
auth_callback rejects a missing PKCE cookie, provider error, missing state, and mismatched state
auth_callback passes the stored verifier as code_verifier to provider.complete_login
auth_callback sets session cookies and clears the PKCE cookie only after a successful provider exchange
start_login creates state and a PKCE verifier/challenge pair
start_login sends state, code_challenge, and code_challenge_method=S256
start_login returns state and verifier in the PKCE cookie payload
complete_login sends code_verifier to the authorization-code token exchange
the browser provider flow does not expose a separate nonce
the PKCE cookie is short-lived with a ten-minute maximum age
the PKCE cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax and is Secure for HTTPS requests

state.comparison: callback state must equal the state stored in the server-managed PKCE cookie

pkce.comparison: the provider exchange receives the verifier paired with the authorization request challenge

nonce.reason: the pinned browser flow exposes state and PKCE, but no separate nonce

failure_semantics.provider_cancellation: reject callback without a session cookie
failure_semantics.pkce_or_code_rejection: reject callback without a session cookie
failure_semantics.malformed_callback: fail closed without a session cookie
